Experience dinner with family
Nov 2023 • Family
The newly opened restaurant is located in An Thuong neighborhood, so my family and I had the opportunity to visit here to enjoy. I am very satisfied with the space of the restaurant, the food and the dedicated service from the lovely staff.
The space of the restaurant is outside and inside, cool outside and cozy inside, very suitable for going with family or on a date.
Regarding food, I eat mainly pizza and beef. The beef is fresh, soft, sweet, delicious pizza that suits my taste.
I'm especially impressed with the staff. They take care of customers very well and are ready to help if I have any requests.
If I have a chance, I will visit again. Thanks!

The quality of the beef is very poor and the price is too expensive
Sep 2023 • Friends
Was invited here for lunch and I found the service quality very low, because there was no air conditioning so there were quite a lot of flies. It feels a bit unhygienic. Next, the quality of the beef is very problematic, perhaps because the chef is new to the job, the beef is overcooked, causing the beef to lose its taste. The sauce is just acceptable but not at all professional. The taste of the sauce seems to be some kind of industrial sauce (almost similar to bo ne) but it's a little better than the sauce at beef restaurants and can't be compared to surrounding restaurants.
